stem: On a field trip, there are 3 adults for every 45 students. Which graph models a relationship with the same unit rate?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with points gradually increasing up to (150, 4)

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with points increasing linearly up to (150, 10)

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with points steeply increasing up to (45, 10)

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with points constant at y = 1 across all x values
